summary: Customer can reset a forgotten password via email
description:
As a registered ACME Shop customer
I want to reset my password by email
So that I can regain access to my account.

## Acceptance Criteria
- A "Forgot password?" link is shown on the sign-in page.
- Submitting a registered email sends a reset link valid for 30 minutes.
- Submitting an unregistered email shows the same confirmation message (no account enumeration).
- The new password must be 12-64 characters long.

## Notes
Rate limiting is handled by the platform team.
